name: flat
title: Launcher action, flat: a pusher on a tapered two-leaf spring, a trigger that is its own sear, printed in one piece on its side
orientation: On its side, as drawn: one piece, no supports. Everything that moves stands on the bed and bends within its layers. Pull the tab at the back to cock it; the trigger's hook catches the pusher's tooth; pull the trigger to let it go.

body.label: The action: frame, spring, pusher and trigger in one print

height.rule: How tall it prints, on its side: the flexures' width, so it sets their force (seventy layers)

stroke.rule: How far the tab pulls the pusher back to cock it

over.rule: How far past the stroke the pusher can go before the back wall stops it: the hard stop

energy.rule: What the spring stores cocked: the launcher's stored energy

safety.rule: The flexures' strain limit is PETG's strength over its modulus (its yield strain) over this

gap.rule: The least gap between parts printed in place that still prints apart

beam_gap.rule: Between the spring's two leaves: the grip's core

block.rule: The spring's base and shuttle blocks, along its leaves

bar.rule: The pusher bar's height: the shuttle, a gap over the back wall, and the tab

tab.rule: How far the cocking tab reaches behind the frame

nose.rule: How far the pusher reaches past the hook: what pushes the disc

tooth.rule: The pusher's tooth, along the bar

engage.rule: How deep the hook catches the tooth

flat.rule: The hook's flat top, between its catch and its ramp

lead.rule: The hook's ramp from the bar: the tooth rides down it when cocking

hinge.rule: The trigger's hinge: a leaf hanging from the frame, the trigger on its tip; it turns about a point 0.15 of the way down

hinge_t.rule: The hinge leaf's thickness: two lines

reach.rule: From the trigger's pivot forward to the hook's catch: a longer reach lowers the hook more for a turn

hanger.rule: The arm the hinge hangs from: its thickness, and how far it reaches past the hinge

blade.rule: The trigger's blade below the hinge: where the finger pulls

arm.rule: The trigger's arm and riser up to the hook

overlap.rule: How far a flexure runs into the body on its tip, so they join solidly

release.rule: The trigger's stop lets it turn this many times as far as the hook's depth over its reach says it must to free the tooth (the turn also swings the hook forward, so the check's measure is more)

pull.rule: A full pull: this much of the way to the trigger's stop

up.rule: The spring's leaves stand up the grip

gamma.rule: A leaf's tip turns about a point this much of its length from the tip (the pseudo-rigid-body model)

guard.rule: Room under the trigger blade, to the guard

slope.rule: The ramp's rise over its run

bite.rule: The hook's catch leans back this far from square, so the spring's push presses it in (a sear with bite): it holds even when slippery, and the trigger presses the pusher back a little to let it go

lean.rule: The catch's lean, run over rise

draw.rule: How far past the stroke the tab is drawn, so the hook springs fully up before the pusher settles back on it (less than over)

taper.rule: How far the spring's leaves follow the bending moment (0 a bar, 1 uniform strength): thick at their ends, thin in their middles, so the strain is spread along them instead of piling up at the ends

spring_round.rule: The round where each spring leaf meets its base and the shuttle: about its thickness, so no square corner concentrates the strain

hinge_round.rule: The round where the trigger's hinge leaf meets the frame's arm and the blade

least.rule: The thinnest a tapered leaf gets: the thinnest wall that prints

into.rule: How far a leaf's rounded end runs on into the block it grows from, so they join solidly

round.rule: Every inside corner of the frame, the pusher and the trigger rounded to this, so no thin arm meets its body at a square corner

margin.rule: The spring is sized to this share of the strain limit by beam theory; the finite-element check then reads its real peak, rounds and taper included
